fields.title: Reis and R30 similarity conventions must be explicit
fields.evidence: The 356.777mm width uses legacy nu=0.33; with Be nu=0.0752 its Reis lambda is about 1.0278. R30 R/t_eq is 164.871, despite R/h=285.565, so the two thickness ratios cannot be interchanged in the thin-shell discussion. R30 FE also uses nu=0.0752 while its 040 source uses 0.0768. These are small arithmetic/convention changes inside a larger unproved sandwich transfer.
fields.proposed_fix: Report both ratios and Poisson conventions. Preserve homogeneous neo-Hookean versus sandwich distinctions and compare R30 against its actual 97.172303kPa design load.

claim: Reis and R30 similarity conventions must be explicit
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: 047's regularizing in-plane core moduli remain unsourced, and its face-compression screen uses a tensile proxy. The 1.209–1.227 mm tolerance at SF1 is model-only. The 056 target, 6.03 MPa, is simulated rather than a physical collapse measurement; 6.159 MPa agreement supplies no P2 gamma. [047 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:7472c3f9ee41a250), [056 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:a6b49a9c06df2016).
